title: Live Dutch → French
processingHelp: Choose before starting. Your choice is saved on this computer. Higher levels may improve wording, but do not guarantee better recognition or translation.

fast.label: 1 · Fast
fast.description: The original behaviour: frequent preliminary captions and short pauses before finalising a sentence.

balanced.label: 2 · Balanced
balanced.description: Waits a little longer for sentence endings and considers more translations. Captions appear less frequently.

thorough.label: 3 · Thorough
thorough.description: Allows longer pauses within a sentence and spends more time comparing translations. Expect slower caption updates.

modelDownload: Download the pinned Ultra and Dutch-to-French models once on this computer.
